data.name: Paraxima
data.detailed_description:
I. ORIENTATION: CONTEXT & STANDARDS

Due to spiking levels of Static activity, the Essential Services Coordination (ESC) has issued immediate lockdown protocols for this sector. Your team has been sent to contain the paranormal breach zone.

Your presence at the site is strictly confidential and necessary to keep The Static at bay. Follow ESC protocol precisely to prevent public hysteria.

II. THE PROTOCOL: ASYMMETRIC CO-OP

Missions require analytical coordination across two distinct roles:

  • Field Agents: Deploy directly into the active event zone. Use agency-issued tools to find and suppress traces of The Static, and observe how the Entity reacts to understand its character.

  • The Operator: Stationed within the operational Safe Room. Monitor team vitals, track general threat levels, view live security camera feeds, and manipulate local building systems to assist the team. Keep communication clear; cutting the lights or triggering environmental overrides can easily be confused with actual paranormal activity.

ESC Mission Protocols:

  • Protocol 01 - Experiment & Observe: The Entity does not follow a manual; it actively monitors and reacts to your noise, light usage, and movement. Conduct calculated, observation-based experiments to understand its hidden rules.

  • Protocol 02 - Calculated Infringements: Following the rules keeps you alive, but it will not close the Breach. To discover the Entity's true identity and initiate containment, your team must strategically trigger paranormal events by breaking Its rules.

  • Protocol 03 - Entering The Static: Elimination does not mean end of mission. Downed agents are cast into the paranormal dimension called The Static. Remaining active participants, you must interact with environmental anomalies to assist - or accidentally terrify - their surviving teammates.

III. POST-MISSION ANALYSIS: SYSTEMIC RECOVERY

Between active missions, your team returns to ESC Headquarters to manage meta-progression, analyze empirical data, and prepare for the next deployment:

  • The Archives: File recovered data, analyze collected clues, and catalog paranormal anomalies within the secure ESC database.

  • Detective’s Desk: Claim your personal office space. Monitor operational resources, track progression milestones, and display hard-earned artifacts and case clues recovered from field missions.

  • Operational Simulation: Access a localized training Breach within Headquarters to calibrate your field equipment and practice basic investigation principles.

Features List

  • Asymmetric Tactical Co-Op: Choose your risk profile. Command building systems from relative safety as the Operator, or brave the immediate paranormal threat on the ground as a Field Agent.

  • Behavioral Action-Reaction Engine: The threat is watching your every move. The Entity monitors player noise, light, and movement in real time, altering its hostility based on how well your team follows - or breaks - its hidden rules.

  • Grounded Neo-Noir Atmosphere: Investigate familiar, recently evacuated public spaces designed to subvert everyday environments into zones of intense psychological tension.

  • The Static: Death is not a spectator sport. Downed players are cast into the paranormal dimension, leaving them free to manipulate anomalies to guide or haunt their living teammates.

  • Deductive Data Extraction: Moving beyond binary evidence tools, survival is a cognitive puzzle. Test theories through deliberate behavioral violations, isolate the Entity’s traits, and seal the Breach before the sector is lost.

data.short_description: 3-player asymmetric co-op horror. Identify the Entity that reacts to how you behave. Investigate in the field as an Agent, or coordinate from the Safe Room as the Operator. Close the breach before everything becomes The Static.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7 4770 or AMD equivalent (AMD FX 9500+ Series)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX11 compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required / Not compatible with Mac products
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 9600 or AMD equivalent (AMD Ryzen 3600+ Series)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or RX 5700-XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX11 compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required / Not compatible with Mac products
